name: ycac-pulse
description: YC&AC Pulse — static season dashboard (GitHub Pages) on a Supabase backend. Test automation: syntax gate + node:test unit tests + 14 live contract verifiers + Playwright E2E (mocked API) + post-deploy smoke.

scripts.setup:dev: npm ci && playwright install chromium && husky
scripts.verify:fast: npm run check:syntax && npm run test:unit
scripts.verify: npm run verify:fast && npm run test:verify && npm run test:e2e
scripts.verify:live: npm run verify && npm run test:verify:live
